name: ceo-inbox-list
description: List recent messages from the principal's email. Only for the ceo-inbox agent: it reads the principal's email.

inputs.folder: string? (Gmail folder/label to list, default 'INBOX'; use 'SENT' for the Sent folder, or 'DRAFTS' to list unsent drafts)
inputs.unread_only: boolean? (if true, only return unread messages, default true; ignored for DRAFTS)
inputs.modified_since: string? (DRAFTS only: ISO 8601 date-time; keep drafts changed at or after it. Resolve 'this morning' with date-resolve)
inputs.triage: boolean? (inbox-drain task only: code picks the due mailboxes and a batch of 5; other filters and mailbox are ignored)
inputs.sweep_since: string? (ISO date, needs mailbox; principal's own request only: move that mailbox's start line back)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.messages: array of { id, threadId, from, to, cc, subject, date, snippet, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size, isCalendarInvite? }], from_principal_other_mailbox? } (for non-draft folders)
outputs.drafts: array of { id, threadId, subject, to, cc, snippet, date, date_local, created_by_curia (null if unknown) } (returned instead of messages when folder is DRAFTS, alongside folder: 'DRAFTS')
outputs.mailboxes_due: string[]? (triage: mailbox ids in this drain)
outputs.backlog: array? of { mailbox, mailbox_label, untriaged_over }: over 100 untriaged (say "over 100"), once
outputs.budget_exhausted: boolean? (triage: daily ceiling hit; tell the principal once, do not continue)
outputs.next_page_token: string? (pass as page_token for the next page)
outputs.mailbox_errors: array? of { mailbox, mailbox_label, error }: mailboxes not checked; say so
outputs.skipped_mailboxes: array? of { mailbox, mailbox_label }: not read on this page; say so
outputs.has_more: boolean — true when more unread messages remain beyond this batch (lets the caller drain the inbox in batches); absent for DRAFTS
outputs.scan_incomplete: boolean? — paging stopped at the cap; more messages (DRAFTS with modified_since: drafts) may remain. With count 0, has_more is false: stop. Triage: count 0 with has_more true means duplicates were set aside: continue
